Message:
wireless: use eth_hw_addr_set()

Convert all WiFi drivers from memcpy(... ETH_ADDR)
to eth_hw_addr_set():

  @@
  expression dev, np;
  @@
  - memcpy(dev->dev_addr, np, ETH_ALEN)
  + eth_hw_addr_set(dev, np)
